name: How can I prevent black spots (mold) from returning after removal?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent black spots (mold) from returning after removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing black spots, or mold, from returning after removal involves controlling moisture levels in your home. Ensure proper ventilation in areas like bathrooms, kitchens, and basements by using exhaust fans and opening windows. Promptly repair any leaks in your roof, plumbing, or appliances. Maintain indoor humidity levels below 60% with dehumidifiers, especially in humid climates or seasons. Clean and dry damp surfaces immediately after they get wet. Regular inspections for signs of moisture and good air circulation are key to long-term prevention.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by controlling moisture: ensure good ventilation, fix leaks promptly, maintain low indoor humidity, and dry wet surfaces immediately.
